description: Keep tracked GitHub lifecycle state consistent without loading full Project v2 payloads into context.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gh_task_status.py" hook pre; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gh_task_status.py" hook pre; else exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gh_task_status.py" hook pre; fi

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gh_task_status.py" hook stop; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gh_task_status.py" hook stop; else exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gh_task_status.py" hook stop; fi
